notes.title: Patch Note 0.9.2

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Refined Artifact acquisition mechanics
[*]Replaced Artifact Chime cost system with single-choice selection
[*]Rebalanced and polished Artifact Chime Talents
[*]Implemented AutoAim functionality
[*]Enhanced VFX and indicator decals for clarity
[*]Added new features to the Settings menu
[*]Various minor UI and UX adjustments
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Resolved input freeze after obtaining Weapon Chime in the starting stage
[*]Fixed rare issue causing unexpected slowdown of game timescale
[*]Corrected malfunctioning Artifact Chime Talents

notes.title: Greetings to the Aksun Community
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/168aa1e6e2f8601740ad6d0b6fc594b828450d24.jpg[/img]
[h1]Greetings, Wanderers![/h1]

We are thrilled to finally reveal [b]Aksun[/b] to the world.

[i]Aksun[/i] is a [b]roguelike action game[/b] born from the echoes of forgotten faiths and twisted devotion. At its heart lies a cursed [b]Casket[/b]—[b]Aksun[/b]—sealed to contain the remnants of a fallen cult and its Evil Prophet.

You have been drawn into this [b]Casket[/b]—[b]Aksun[/b], into the Seal itself, where broken spirits, once worshippers and betrayers alike, clash endlessly. Each encounter is a test. Each fall draws you closer to an unsettling truth.

[h2]Core Experience[/h2]

Fast, visceral combat merging intense responsiveness with overwhelming enemy hordes
Deep strategic growth through shamanic weapons, spiritual artifacts, and fateful choices
A haunting narrative where failure becomes growth, and salvation walks hand in hand with ruin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/f72d3e840cd8f3f25972a1cbbc801b46eacaf261.png[/img]
[h2]Demo Launch[/h2]
[b]May, 2025[/b] Our first public demo will offer a glimpse into Aksun's depths — and the horrors that whisper from within.

[h2]Join Our Journey[/h2]
Our official [b]Discord community[/b] will open alongside the demo! Come share your feedback, theories, and your own stories carved through survival and despair.

Prepare yourself. Aksun does not shatter. It merely waits... for the next soul.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/ca67c4e29d80b15186b5d83a600c7266f97ca887.png[/img]

[h2]The Aksun Team[/h2]

[i]We started this project as a one-person development effort in [b]November 2023[/b], with a relentless passion to create a roguelite that combines [b]superior action, strategic depth, and a compelling world[/b].Today, [b]a team of 6 to 10 talented developers[/b] has gathered to bring Aksun to life.[/i]

[b]If you find our vision intriguing, please add Aksun to your Wishlist on Steam![/b] Your support makes a huge difference in our journey.

[i]Thank you for reading. We can't wait to share this journey with you.[/i]
